title: Hacker House Medellín (mash web)
description: hhm-mash-web registers its own deployable Maud/HTMX/WebSocket surface plus an hhm.component.v1 discovery manifest and inert component fragments.

Health.doc: Built inline with serde_json::json!, so the field names below are the whole contract.

database.doc: True when DATABASE_URL was set and the SeaORM connection succeeded at boot.

demo_writes_enabled.doc: True only when unauthenticated demo writes were explicitly requested and the server is bound to a loopback host.

state_durable.doc: False today: the reservation demo list is process-local memory.

NewItem.doc: The urlencoded body of the HTMX create form. Both fields are required: the Rust struct has no defaults, and both inputs carry the HTML `required` attribute.

ComponentDescriptor.doc: One inert server-rendered component advertised by the component manifest.

executable.doc: False for these HTML fragments; clients must not treat them as executable code.

home.summary: Server-rendered dashboard (maud) with the HTMX create form.

healthz.summary: Liveness plus which optional backends are configured.

component_manifest.summary: Discover the inert HTML components this service exposes and the runtimes allowed to display them.

reservations_component.summary: Server-rendered reservation cards for browser or sandboxed Flutter WebView display.

leptos_capabilities_component.summary: Inert Leptos SSR capability fragment describing the supported MASH rendering boundary.

list_reservations_partial.summary: The reservation list as an HTML fragment, swapped into #items by HTMX.

create_reservation_partial.summary: Append an item from the browser form and re-render the list fragment. Returns HTML, not JSON.

reservation_events.summary: Websocket upgrade. Frames are the plain-text string `created:<uuid>`, not JSON; the page uses them only as a hint to re-fetch the list fragment.
